answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities: every slot costs a deposit only real work earns back. A newcomer stakes 60 credits for one slot and finishes ten verified tasks, light as a plume. A zephyr of spot checks samples tasks; copied work burns the deposit and the slot closes. Forging 500 fakes costs 500 x 60 = 30,000 credits, while each fake earns at most 40. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps every reward, rooted like a willow.
